mapper.select: select (select count(*) from product where status = 1) as on_sale_count, (select count(*) from product where status = 0) as pending_audit_count, (select count(*) from orders where status = 5) as sold_count, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) from orders where status = 5) as total_amount, (select ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) from product) as total_view_count, (select count(*) from `user`) as total_user_count, (select count(*) from orders where create_time >= curdate()) as today_order_count, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) from orders where status = 5 and receive_time is not null and receive_time >= curdate()) as today_amount

select date(create_time) as stat_date, count(*) as stat_value from user_behavior_log where behavior_type = #{behaviorType} and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by stat_date

select date(create_time) as stat_date, count(*) as stat_value from orders where create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by stat_date

select date(receive_time) as stat_date, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as stat_value from orders where status = 5 and receive_time is not null and receive_time >= #{start} and receive_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(receive_time) order by stat_date
select status, count(*) as cnt from product group by status order by status

select p.category_id as category_id, max(c.name) as category_name, ifnull(sum(o.quantity), 0) as sales_count, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as sales_amount from orders o join product p on p.id = o.product_id left join category c on c.id = p.category_id where o.status = 5 group by p.category_id order by sales_amount desc limit #{limit}
